summary.text: Dylan Behler is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 30A, in Anne Arundel County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former legislative staff member, he was appointed to the House in February 2025 and sits on the Environment and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Behler was born in Annapolis in 1998, graduated from Southern High School in Lothian in 2016, and earned a B.A. in political science and government from the University of Maryland in 2020.

He worked as a legislative aide, legislative director and then chief of staff in the office of Maryland Senator Sarah Elfreth from 2019 to 2023, and was director of legislative and constituent services at the Maryland Department of Natural Resources from 2023 to 2024.
He was a member of the Anne Arundel County Democratic Central Committee from 2019 to 2025 and has served on the Anne Arundel County Public Library Board of Trustees since 2023.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed Behler to the House of Delegates on February 6, 2025, to replace Shaneka Henson.
He serves on the Environment and Transportation Committee and its Agriculture and Aquaculture, Energy, and Environment subcommittees.
